review:
A cluster game full of mice, with Super Cascades that clear every symbol of a winning type. A cheese symbol in a winning cluster goes further – it clears the whole grid except FS symbols and wild multipliers.

Those wilds hop to a new spot after every cascade: normal ones start at 1x and add +1x per jump, Epic ones start at 10x and add +10x, with up to four on the board. A long cascade with an Epic wild bouncing around is the road to the 10,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
